note: UK front-of-pack traffic-light criteria, Tables 2 and 3 (pages 19-20) of the guidance PDF, which is dated "Updated November 2016" and carries no withdrawal notice on gov.uk. VERIFIED on 2026-08-19: a person opened the source PDF and confirmed the figures against this file. Before that, on 2026-08-17, all 26 figures had been transcribed three times independently by readers who were never shown these values, and two adversarial readers tried and failed to refute the result. Two adversarial findings were acted on and are the things most easily got wrong here: the portion-size threshold is 100g for foods but 150ml for drinks (it was one number for both, which made drink portions between 100 and 150ml eligible for a red they had not earned), and the boundary operators are written down - LOW is "<= lowMax" INCLUSIVE, HIGH is "> highMin" EXCLUSIVE, so a value exactly on the high cut-off is MEDIUM. See docs/REFERENCE_VERIFICATION.md.
